comment: Pinned W2 check corpus (Phase 67). Every case is run through BOTH the native CLI (morphic check, accept = exit 0) and the playground's WASM module (the same pkg/ the page loads). Accept/reject must agree on every case; stage and bindability expectations are asserted against the WASM report. Expectations were pinned from measured dialect behaviour, including two permissive corners: unknown TYPE names are accepted (they read as user-defined types), and call arity is not checked by the typechecker — the dialect's real mismatch rejection is operand typing, pinned by operand-type-mismatch.

synthesisComment: W3 synthesis pins (Phase 68). Fractions, outcome kinds, and winner-body hashes were measured from the NATIVE interpreter first (the config-gated harness api::tests::w3_gate_fractions_match_native_interpreter, run in the no-Z3/no-runner configuration — the browser build's own semantics — which also asserts the API's winner body is the pipeline's crowned body and that run_spec_tests on that identical body reproduces the fraction). This runner then asserts the WASM build reproduces every pin, so WASM == native on identical bodies by transitivity. The runner also audits the built site's UI copy: the word 'Verified' must not appear in index.html, src/main.js, or styles.css.
